prompt: Who was the president of the United States when the resort housing the BomBora steel roller coaster first opened?
answer: Grover Cleveland was president when Lagoon’s predecessor, Lake Park, first opened in 1886. He was also president when the resort reopened at its present Farmington location in 1896.
